text:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick ask 5: we need a single cutoff for 2026 401(k) deferrals + catch-up on the handbook. What should we publish?

Tom (Payroll): Operationally: final payroll upload to RetireCo must be in by 2026-12-22 18:00 PT to guarantee posting in 2026. Banking holidays can still affect posting.

Renee (Benefits): RetireCo says they close imports 12/24 EOD but won't promise retro acceptance after close. They bill for retro fixes.

Aisha (People Ops): Draft line: "Submit changes by 2026-12-22 18:00 PT to ensure contributions post in 2026; late changes may post in Jan and could incur fees." Good?

Marco (Finance): Fine. Add a short line about catch-up eligibility: if employee turns 50 on or before 2026-12-31, they're eligible for catch-up for the year.

Tom (Payroll): Also note: final reconciliation should be done by 12/22 12:00 PT to allow fixes.

Renee (Benefits): For HSA/FSA: final deductions follow payroll submission. If someone terminates before cutoff, deductions stop; after cutoff, they may appear on final check. FSA runout/claims follow plan docs.

Aisha (People Ops): Good. One more: who handles retro requests and what's the email + timeline?

Renee (Benefits): Send retro requests to benefits@redwood.com within 30 days. Vendor may reject or charge fees; we'll triage.

Benefits Bot: Reminder: publish benefits page update and FAQ by 2026-12-01.

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks team 5 I'll post this wording and include the contact + catch-up note. Reply if anything needs changing.

Tom (Payroll): Confirmed from payroll side.

Marco (Finance): Confirmed on fees note.
